meta.title: Delete line item with trailing space in title works and returns to PR pool

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ on its Overview tab as the buyer.

args.goal: delete the line item titled exactly "QA_Platform Item A " from the RFQ, return to the Open Purchase Requisitions list, and leave the screen showing the returned item with quantity 10

steps.note: Perform the line-item deletion and navigation to the PR pool, which has no dedicated catalog action.
Verify the returned PR item is displayed with the trimmed title and quantity 10 available.
